title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management triage agent summaries in Microsoft Defender
summary: The briefing says Microsoft provides no guidance for summaries in Defender, although its cited tenant notice supplies rollout and readiness guidance. It also asserts that summaries expose named users without establishing that detail; the rollout facts, licensing model and principal controls are otherwise supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to display IRM triage agent summaries on IRM alerts in the Defender alert queue.
claims.quote: We're introducing support for Insider Risk Management (IRM) alert agent summaries within Microsoft Defender, enabling investigators to access key triage insights directly in the Defender alert queue.
